summary: Vivani Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on June 24, 2026, and related director elections and shareholder votes. The filing discloses that the omnibus incentive plan amendment was approved, increasing authorized shares by 11 million, but no special situation event—such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring—is involved. The report includes routine items like election of directors and advisory vote on executive compensation. As this is a standard corporate governance update, it does not qualify as a special situation filing.
